name: Dscout Researcher
description:
The Dscout MCP unlocks your study data and lets your favorite AI tools use it as real-time context, bringing your research projects inline with your AI workflows. Say goodbye to copying responses and pasting them into Claude for help with analysis. Gone are the days of building prototypes in one tool and designing research around them in another. With the Dscout MCP, you can do it all in the tools you're already using.

Some key use cases for the Dscout MCP include:

Draft research - Describe what you're trying to learn and get a ready-to-launch study
Launch studies - Open studies to participants without switching tools
Analyze findings - Pull in participant responses and let Claude help you surface patterns and insights
Look up participants - Check profiles, submissions, and quality signals on the fly

Dscout for Claude keeps your research workflow in one place, from drafting a study to analyzing what you find.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Dscout Researcher to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Dscout Researcher to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.dscout.com/astro/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Dscout Researcher MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dscout Researcher lists 42 MCP tools, including add_questions_from_bank, apply_study_plan, check_launch_readiness, cite_evidence, clone_study, compute_study_metric, create_clip, create_project, create_study_from_template, delete_question_group, delete_screener_question, and delete_study_question.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Dscout Researcher?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Dscout Researcher in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Dscout Researcher MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dscout Researcher requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Dscout Researcher is developed by Dscout Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
